explanation: Electrical power cannot be stored in the wires. Any gap between what loads demand and what sources deliver is covered by the battery until it cannot be, then loads go dark.

inputs.label: Battery state of charge
inputs.mechanism: With the battery empty, loads the array cannot cover are shed

inputs.label: Generation vs rated
inputs.mechanism: Too little generation leaves demand unmet once the battery is empty

label: Unmet demand (load shed)
